summary: iter482 P5 (Payer-Bears-Stripe-Processing-Cost) end-to-end verification. Backend: 270/270 tests PASS (31/31 new P5 tests + 14/14 P4 e2e + 225/225 iter482 regression covering P0/P2/P3/P3.1/P4A/matrix). Gross-up math, L-1 open gate, offline-zero reason codes, Path A/Path B reconciliation, application_fee-includes-recovery invariant, and all three seller_commission_invoice HTTP endpoints (GET breakdown / POST pay-now stripe / POST pay-now offline / POST pay-now non-owner 403) all green. HOWEVER a HIGH-priority frontend bug was found: when the buyer switches to an offline method (cash / etransfer / cheque) the sidebar 'Résumé' STILL shows the Stripe recovery (3,44 $) and Total 107,98 $ instead of 0 $ / 104,54 $. The main-card processing-fee-section IS hidden correctly (line 652 gates on paymentMethod==='stripe'), but the sidebar block at CheckoutPage.js lines 836-847 is NOT gated and buyerTotal is not recomputed on method change — this violates the acceptance criterion 'switching between Stripe and offline hides/shows the processing row correctly. Offline methods always $0.'

minor.issue: Per-IP rate limit ~1 req/min still causes test_iter482_p4_end_to_end HTTP tests to 429 on cold-run. 60s cool-down clears it. Same non-blocking flake as iteration_462.

ui_bugs.issue: When paymentMethod switches from stripe to cash/etransfer/cheque, the sidebar processing-fee row STILL shows Stripe recovery (3,44 $) and Total STILL shows 107,98 $ instead of 0 $ / 104,54 $. Only the main-card processing-fee-section is correctly hidden (line 652). Sidebar block (lines 836-847, testid=checkout-summary-processing) is unconditionally rendered from breakdown.payment_processing.amount_cents which was fetched under Stripe assumptions, and buyerTotal is not recomputed on method change.

integration_issues.issue: Client does not refetch or client-adjust the breakdown when paymentMethod changes; sidebar therefore diverges from the (correctly hidden) main card. Fix: gate sidebar processing row on paymentMethod==='stripe' AND subtract processing from buyerTotal when offline (or refetch breakdown with ?method=cash).

action_items: Fix CheckoutPage.js sidebar (lines 836-847): gate the checkout-summary-processing row on paymentMethod==='stripe' (mirroring line 652), OR display 0 $ with reason_code=offline_method when non-stripe.

Recompute buyerTotal (or the sidebar Total line at ~858-861) when paymentMethod changes so Total drops from 107,98 $ to 104,54 $ for cash/etransfer/cheque. Simplest: subtract breakdown.payment_processing.amount_cents/100 from the displayed total when paymentMethod !== 'stripe', or refetch breakdown with the selected method as a query param.
OPTIONAL DX: replace /api/auth/register calls inside test_iter482_p4_end_to_end with a session-scoped fixture that reuses testbuyer/testseller to eliminate the 429 flake on full-suite runs.
critical_code_review_comments: Divergence between CheckoutPage main-card (correctly gated) and sidebar (ungated) is a maintainability smell — both should share a single derived value like `visibleProcessingCents = paymentMethod==='stripe' ? breakdown.payment_processing.amount_cents : 0` computed once at component level.

Seller Commission Invoice page uses testids `pay-method-{stripe|etransfer|cash|cheque}` while Checkout uses `payment-method-{...}`. Consider unifying the naming for testability. Also `line-stripe-recovery` remains rendered with $0.00 for offline methods (with reason 'Hors ligne — 0 $') which is correct per spec — good.

Seller invoice PAY NOW offline flow returns human-readable instructions inline (Contact BidVex support to arrange in-person cash payment) — good UX. However there is no visible success toast / confirmation banner or link to the persisted invoice record; consider surfacing the invoice_id for user reference.

Backend gross-up formula recovery = ceil((base × r + f) / (1 − r)) verified cent-exact across CA/international × $7/$100/$1000; application_fee=BP+SC+fees_tax+recovery invariant asserted by test_application_fee_includes_recovery — Path A ↔ Path B reconcile cent-exact for all 6 param sets.
Rate-limit on /api/auth/register (60s window) continues to be the only friction in full-suite backend runs — same observation as iteration_462.

rca of the issue: Buyer CheckoutPage.js: the price breakdown is loaded ONCE from the backend at mount and stored in `breakdown` state. `breakdown.payment_processing.amount_cents` is populated by the server based on default (stripe) assumption. On method change, `setPaymentMethod(...)` is called but no refetch happens and no client-side derivation is applied to zero-out processing for offline. The main-card processing section was updated for P5 (line 652 gates on stripe) but the parallel sidebar block at lines 836-847 was not — an incomplete refactor. Total (`buyerTotal`) is derived from the original breakdown so it also does not update. Reproduce: login testbuyer → /checkout/iter482p4-e2e-multi-1d5c7d → click Comptant → observe sidebar still shows Frais de traitement du paiement 3,44 $ and Total 107,98 $. Mitigation: gate lines 836-847 on paymentMethod==='stripe' and adjust displayed Total accordingly (or refetch breakdown with selected method).
